Templates.Title: Message templates
Templates.Sub: Manage your WhatsApp Business message templates. Submit drafts to Meta for approval — once approved, they can be used to start conversations outside the 24-hour window.
Templates.Empty.Title: No templates yet
Templates.Empty.Sub: Create a template to start sending pre-approved messages outside the 24-hour reply window.
Templates.Empty.ArchivedSub: Templates you delete here are kept for audit and to reserve the name with Meta for 30 days.
Templates.Col.Name: Name
Templates.Editor.Title: New template
Templates.Field.Name: Template name
Templates.Field.NameHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, and underscores only. Must start with a letter.
Templates.Field.BodyHelp: Use {{1}}, {{2}}, … for variables. They must be sequential and may not start or end the message.
Templates.Field.FooterHelp: Up to 60 characters. Plain text only — no variables. Required by Meta for marketing templates (e.g. opt-out instructions).
Templates.Validation.NameFormat: Use lowercase letters, digits, and underscores only — must start with a letter.
Templates.Validation.NameTaken: A template with this name and language already exists.
Templates.Validation.LeadingVariable: Body cannot start with a variable. Add some text before {{1}}.
Templates.Validation.TrailingVariable: Body cannot end with a variable. Add some text after the last {{n}}.
Templates.Validation.VariableInvalid: Variables must look like {{1}}, {{2}}, … with no spaces.
Templates.Validation.VariableNotSequenti: Variables must be sequential starting from {{1}} — no gaps.
Templates.Validation.CategoryServiceNotA: Service is not a valid template category — use Utility, Marketing, or Authentication.
Templates.Error.NotConfigured: WhatsApp Business is not configured. Add a Meta WABA id and access token in app settings, then try again.
Templates.Error.AuthFailed: Meta rejected the access token. Rotate the token and retry — the background sync will pause until then.
Templates.Error.RateLimited: You've hit Meta's submission limit for this hour.
Templates.Error.SyncFailed: Couldn't reach Meta to sync. Try again in a moment.
Templates.Toast.SyncDone: Synced — {0} on Meta, {1} updated, {2} imported, {3} orphaned.
Templates.Toast.RateLimited: Submission limit reached. Try again in {0} minute(s).
Templates.Confirm.Archive: Archive this template? Meta reserves the name for 30 days before it can be reused.
Templates.Preflight.NoBusinessInstance: Connect a WhatsApp Business account to create templates. Templates are only used by Cloud-API instances.
Templates.Preflight.NotConfigured: Meta WABA is not configured. Set Meta:Graph:WabaId and Meta:Graph:AccessToken in app settings to start submitting templates.
Templates.Preflight.AuthFailure: The Meta access token was rejected on the last call. Rotate the token in app settings — submissions and the status sync are paused until then.
Templates.Preflight.RateLimitedNow: You've used your hourly submission allowance. New submits will be blocked until the oldest one rolls off.
